description: Selected character record is read at index who; the other seven records hold distinct active decoys. 0x4ee9d0 and 0x523330 (D4 formula nodes) are address-stubbed: their arguments and call counts are outputs, return values are ignored by the caller. 0x590950 runs natively with wcscpy/wcslen stubbed; its call is observed as one wcscat call whose source pointer is chosen by the first character of the formatted notice (synthetic formats, first characters are inputs). Division by a zero maximum stamina with nonzero current stamina faults in the original and is excluded from inputs (maximum >= 1 except when current equals maximum).
